# EvoDesign

> An open-source AI workspace for editable diagram generation, refinement and personal design memory.

EvoDesign runs locally using the user's own vision-capable model endpoint. It includes a React canvas workspace, FastAPI backend, agentic generation engine and rendering service. Users can generate diagrams, refine them, edit canvas objects, request local edits, save/reopen projects and export results. Icons are optional. Personal DNA rules cover structure, style and layout; a portable example and import/export utility are provided.

## Research
- [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09568): EvoDesign: Agentic Editable Diagram Creation via Design Expertise Evolution.
- [Reproducibility notes](https://github.com/GeminiLight/EvoDesign/blob/main/docs/reproducibility.md)
- [Citation](https://tianfu.wang/EvoDesign/citation.bib)

The project website contains an interactive illustration, not a hosted model-generation service. Result tables are manuscript-reported results, not an independent reproduction of this maintained release. Training and test datasets are not included in the initial code release. The former internal name EvoDiagram persists in Python imports for compatibility; the project and algorithm are EvoDesign.
